svg.text: every cell is a cosine; the diagonal is the only thing that should win its row
Row 2 is a five-class classification problem
One positive, four negatives, and a softmax across the row —
so the batch is the label set. Thread 11 all over again: cross-entropy
over logits, where the logits are cosines divided by a temperature.
so a harder task and a lower
— the only reason to want one
